content.short: Only 1,000 rare limited edition Cardano Bandits NFTs.
content.description:
Cardano Bandits is an NFT project on the Cardano blockchain. The collection includes a total of only 1000 NFTs. The NFTs were created through hard work and are graphically high quality. Since 2021 it is possible to mine Cardano Blockchain NFTs, so Cardano Bandits is one of the first projects.

The process of buying a Cardano Bandits NFT is elementary. Just press the green button on the Cardanobandits.com website and send 8 $ADA from your Daedalus or Yoroi wallte to the address given there. Within minutes you will receive your Cardano Bandits NFT in your wallet. Other accepted wallets are Nami, Eternl/cc, GeroWallet, Flint, Typhon Wallet, CardWallet. Be quick before the collection is sold out!
